data.name: Broadside Bash（舷炮乱斗）
data.detailed_description:
Broadside Bash is a first-person 4v4 multiplayer naval combat party game. Team up with your friends to crew a warship, taking on different roles as you steer the vessel, fire the cannons, repair damage, and fight off enemy players.

Trade devastating broadsides, leap aboard the enemy ship for close-quarters combat, or simply ram straight into them!

Powered by a physics-based destruction system, cannon fire and collisions can tear ships apart and send debris flying across the deck. Coordinate with your crew, embrace the chaos, and sink the enemy ship to claim victory in an all-out battle at sea.

Broadside Barrage, Sink Enemy Ships

Take control of your warship and enter the battlefield with your crew. Search for the perfect firing angle, adjust your course, bring the enemy ship into your broadside range, load your cannons, and unleash a devastating volley.

Cannon fire does more than deal damage — it tears ships apart. Wooden planks splinter, structures collapse, and every hit pushes the enemy vessel closer to destruction. Keep targeting their weak points until the entire ship disappears beneath the waves.

Board Enemy Ships and Finish the Fight Yourself

Cannons are not your only weapon.

When two ships get close enough, you can jump into the sea, swim toward the enemy vessel, and find a chance to board their deck.

Grab your weapon and fight the enemy crew at close range. Take down their gunners, disrupt repairs, or tear apart their ship from the inside.

If cannon fire can't solve the problem, go there and solve it yourself.

The Ship Is Sinking? Patch It Up First.

Every enemy volley can leave your ship damaged.

The longer the battle continues, the closer your vessel gets to total collapse.

Find damaged areas and repair them in time to keep your ship afloat. The enemy won't give you a moment to breathe — you may need to fix your ship while under heavy fire, or rescue fallen teammates in the middle of battle.

Sometimes, surviving the next volley matters more than landing one yourself.

Paint Your Own Crew

Don't want to look like everyone else?

Use the character customization painting system to create a unique appearance for your crew. Change colors, draw patterns, or create strange designs that only your friends can recognize.

If you're going to get blasted away by a cannonball eventually, you might as well look unforgettable when you fly through the air.

Every Battle Can Spiral Out of Control

Plans never survive the next cannonball.

The enemy is firing a volley.
The hull is damaged.
Your teammate is down on the deck.
Someone is repairing the ship.
Someone has already jumped into the sea.
And an enemy you didn't notice has somehow boarded your ship.

Broadside Bash is a first-person 4V4 multiplayer naval battle party game.

Fight alongside your friends as you command warships through cannon fire, collisions, gunfights, and constantly breaking vessels.

Sink the enemy ship — or at least sink after they do.

data.short_description: Team up with friends in a chaotic 4v4 naval battle! Fire broadsides, board enemy ships, brawl on deck, or ram them at full speed. Physics-based destruction lets cannonballs tear through hulls and collisions send debris flying. Sink the enemy before your own ship goes down!
data.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4 GB or AMD Radeon R9 380 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. An active Steam account and internet connection are required for online multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. An active Steam account and a stable internet connection are recommended for online multiplayer.
